version.changelog: fix: normalize retry strategy time units from skill and dashboard updates

llm.summary: The skill is transparent about its monitoring purpose, but it depends on a force-installed companion plugin and includes a local dashboard with review-worthy security concerns.

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose matches the exposed tools: error statistics, retry strategy management, reports, dashboard access, and recovery status. Strategy and recovery updates are mutating actions, but they are described in the skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The dashboard-opening phrases are somewhat broad, but they are visible examples and aligned with the dashboard feature rather than hidden behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs users to install the separate @leiJack-lo/resilience plugin with --dangerously-force-unsafe-install, enable conversation access for a hook, and restart the gateway. That authority is disclosed, but the companion plugin code is outside this skill artifact and carries the main runtime risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The local dashboard reads operational telemetry and can change retry strategy settings. Its JavaScript renders several API/log-derived values into innerHTML without evident escaping, which could let crafted log or API data affect the dashboard page.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The documented companion plugin registers automatic hooks, starts a local HTTP server, and persists logs/configuration under ~/.openclaw/plugins/resilience/. This fits the purpose, but it is broad and persistent enough to warrant user review.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust the @leiJack-lo/resilience plugin, are comfortable with OpenClaw error/session telemetry being logged locally, and understand that enabling conversation access gives the plugin more visibility into agent runs. Prefer invoking the dashboard with the Resilience name explicitly, and review or harden the dashboard before exposing it beyond localhost.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad dashboard invocation examples are real, but opening a dashboard is an advertised feature and the issue is better treated as accidental-activation risk than malicious behavior.
